Maya (eng-ml): fyi nightly-sweep cron failed ~00:10 UTC. job id sweep-2026-03-17-001. quick log snippet: `fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': No such device or address` and later: `bench_kv_cache_test::test_cleanup - PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied`
Liam (oncall): thanks, I'll take a look and kick a rerun. can you paste the full CI job url?
Maya (eng-ml): https://ci.redwood/reports/job/sweep-2026-03-17-001 — logs attached in the job. I suspect the checkout/auth bit is the root but the bench failure shows up after.
InfraBot: [automated] CI pipeline failed for sweep-2026-03-17-001 — https://ci.redwood/reports/job/sweep-2026-03-17-001/logs (exit 1)
Sofia (infra): we rotated the deploy key last night for runner-workers. @Liam (oncall) / @Maya (eng-ml) any chance the runner didn't pick up the new key? that `could not read Username` smells like creds.
Ashley (bench): also worth noting `bench_kv_cache_test::test_cleanup` has flaked a few times in the past week (3/10). could be a timing/permissions race exposed by a partial checkout. try a clean workspace rerun first.
Liam (oncall): kicking a rerun with CLEAN_WS=1 now and forcing a fresh checkout. queued as sweep-2026-03-17-001-retry1. if that still fails i'll run a bisect between last green and HEAD.
Maya (eng-ml): thanks — last known green commit on sweep job was `abc1234` and HEAD at failure is `def5678`. please bisect if retry fails.
InfraBot: [automated] Rerun queued: sweep-2026-03-17-001-retry1 — https://ci.redwood/reports/job/sweep-2026-03-17-001-retry1
Sofia (infra): confirmed the runner key rotation didn't propagate to one pool (sweeper-runners). infra will push the fix in ~10m. if the retry passes, we still need a postmortem follow-up to update key rotation tooling.
Liam (oncall): noted. i'll watch the retry and post results here. if it fails i'll start the bisect and tag owners for the failing test. :thumbsup:
Maya (eng-ml): perfect — thanks all. will update the ticket (INFRA-412) with the logs and link to this thread.
Ashley (bench): if you need me to run the flaky test locally with race detectors, ping and i'll spin it up.
Liam (oncall): sweep-2026-03-17-001-retry1 moved to running -> success :party: (12:03 UTC) — marking as likely transient, but leaving INFRA-412 open until key rotation fix is deployed.
